subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should interrupted subagent completion announce delivery be persisted as announceLastRun and reconciled to a non-running session without human restart recovery?
rationale: The code path fixes the reported cascade, but it deliberately changes durable session lifecycle state and tool availability for internal delivery turns, so automation should not merge it without maintainer ownership of that model.

options.title: Accept this recovery model after CI is clean
options.body: Proceed with the persisted announce marker, killed/non-running reconciliation, and tool-free announce delivery once relevant checks pass.

options.title: Adjust the terminal state before merge
options.body: Ask for a smaller change if maintainers want a different non-running state than killed for interrupted announce delivery.

options.title: Pause for a broader delivery-turn model
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want a larger lifecycle abstraction before changing restart recovery semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept this recovery model after CI is clean
